title: Rhodium: China's biggest tech companies are set to double capex to $139B in 2026 with AI lab revenue under 8% of it, a gap that may matter more than chip curbs (New York Times)
summary: New York Times: Rhodium: China's biggest tech companies are set to double capex to $139B in 2026 with AI lab revenue under 8% of it, a gap that may matter more than chip curbs — While Anthropic and other Silicon Valley A.I. giants are raising tens of billions in capital, Chinese rivals are struggling to keep pace financially.
